bollymeter.basis: Yoo Yeon-seok and Chae Soo-bin's chemistry and MBC Best Couple award recognition are genuine assets; a deteriorating final arc and IMDb score of 5.9 reflect a gap between promising setup and payoff.

seasons.review_body: When the Phone Rings opens as a tight political-thriller romance: Yoo Yeon-seok's frost-behind-the-smile presidential spokesman and Chae Soo-bin's mute, outwardly compliant wife are a compelling opposites-in-an-arranged-marriage pairing, and the kidnap plot injects genuine tension into their dynamic. The drama earned Yoo and Chae the Best Couple award at the 2024 MBC Drama Awards, which is honest recognition of what the first two-thirds deliver. The back three episodes drew sharper criticism: the thriller resolution felt rushed and the emotional climax was called disconnected from the setup by a notable share of viewers. The IMDb score of 5.9 reflects this ending drag, though MyDramaList audience ratings sat appreciably higher for the series overall. Western trade critics did not review the drama. A worthwhile watch for the lead performances; the finale will divide.
